## 💡 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Please describe the pain point or limitation you're facing.

**Example:** I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 💭 Proposed Solution

Describe your ideal solution or how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Use Cases

Describe specific use cases where this feature would be valuable:

1. **Use Case 1**: ...
2. **Use Case 2**: ...

## 📎 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or references to similar features in other projects.

## 🔗 Related Issues / PRs

Link to any related issues or pull requests if applicable.
